name: LED Light Bar for MakerGear M2

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a semi-cylindrical LED light bar designed to mount onto a flat surface. It has a long, half-pipe shape with a hollow interior channel running along its length. Six circular, counterbored holes are evenly spaced along the curved top surface to house LEDs, angled slightly for directed illumination. The flat bottom edges of the half-cylinder provide a stable surface for adhesive mounting.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric LED light bar as an OpenSCAD script. The model should feature a semi-cylindrical hollow bar with adjustable diameter, length, and number of LED holes. Users should be able to configure the rotation angle of the LED holes and toggle the visualization of the 3D LED models inside the bar.
captions.factory: The lightBar module is constructed using boolean difference operations. First, a main solid cylinder is cut in half by subtracting a cube, and then hollowed out by subtracting a smaller concentric cylinder. A for-loop iterates through the LED_Count to subtract stepped cylindrical holes, which are translated along the bar's length and rotated by ledRotation. The led module uses a sphere, cylinders, and cubes to optionally render the physical 5mm LEDs within the assembly.
